Inner Voices

A science-fiction RPG, where we explore the differences between humans' minds...

videogame

Greetings.

You do not know me, but soon we will become familiarised.
Or rather, you will become familiarized with my creation(s).

"Inner Voices."

I have been planning it for a long, long time; now I begin to craft this amazing thing that took over my life.

Can you hear the chirp of the birds in this quiet morning?

You will feel happy and smile.
You will feel pain.
You will feel warm and comforted.
You will feel cold and alone.

The coward, The estranged,
The rebel, The denier,
The thinker, The hopeless,
The helpless, The unimportant.

Soon you will meet their worlds.

Once it is not occluded by the darkness of your eyelids.

I wait for you, my friend.
Together we will create something really, truly, extraordinary.

Soon.

Pedro Braga.
